question: The entry into force of the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation on 12 August 2026 is imposing a crippling administrative burden on businesses, especially SMEs. Due to the lack of clarity caused by the delay in the explanatory guidelines and lack of implementing acts, economic operators are having to move ahead without any direction.

This situation directly penalises honest entrepreneurs, undermining our SMEs and e-commerce. Given the current technical uncertainty and the fact that some implementing acts are not yet operational, does the Commission intend to ask the Member States to relax the transition conditions by granting an official moratorium on penalties in order to protect our companies, in particular our SMEs?
